firm_data.firm_description: Lasser Law Group is a real estate, construction and commercial litigation law firm with offices in Manhattan, Long Island and Westchester, which serves the entire New York metropolitan area including the Hudson Valley. Our clients include landlords, developers, cooperative corporations, condominium associations, contractors and business owners.
notable_facts: Represents over 200 cooperative, condominium and homeowners associations throughout the five boroughs of New York City and Westchester, Rockland, Orange, Ulster, Dutchess, Nassau and Putnam Counties.
Provides a free seminar series, including one on avoiding discrimination claims for Co-op, Condo and HOA Boards.

email.subject: AI for Lasser Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Stephen,

With over 200 cooperative, condominium and homeowners associations across five boroughs and seven counties, your firm handles the complexity that demands precision and efficiency at scale.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in your region to meet firms doing real estate, construction, and commercial litigation work. I'd be happy to stop by your Manhattan office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
